meta.disclaimer: Not a cadastral map and not one real town. Street names are placeholders in streets.json. Household location_label stays the fixture district. Plots are local metres, not home addresses. F12's blue temple and F06's north hall are the invented landmarks from the fixtures.
meta.projection: fixed isometric 2:1. x east, y south toward the camera. z up.
